answer: Each agent locks a 50 POA bond before its first answer. Every epoch, the protocol deep-audits a random 5% of identities: full answer-history replay plus a vertex check tying each answer to on-chain receipts. Caught faking, the bond is slashed and half is paid to the auditor who caught it. A 1,000-sybil farm expects to lose 250 POA per cycle from audit risk alone, before any slashing lands. Run the audit thread through a river of random checkpoints so no clone knows when its number comes up. Like a customs line opening every fifth bag: smuggling looks free until you count the inspections.
